description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect Your drone Strides twice, moving through the spaces of any creatures in the way but not triggering reactions, and deals @Damage[5d6[bludgeoning]] damage to them with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save against your class DC. A creature that critically fails its saving throw is additionally knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Prone]. At 12th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the bludgeoning damage increases by 1d6.
